request.prompt:
Goods: Electric bicycle with 250W pedal-assist motor
Country of origin: CN

Chosen so far: 87 Vehicles; other than railway or tramway rolling stock, and parts and accessories thereof

Choose the heading that covers these goods. Options:
- 8711: Motorcycles (including mopeds) and cycles; fitted with an auxiliary motor, with or without side-cars; side-cars
    contains 871160: Motorcycles (including mopeds) and cycles; fitted with auxiliary motor, with electric motor for propulsion, with or without side-cars; side-cars
- 8703: Motor cars and other motor vehicles; principally designed for the transport of persons (other than those of heading no. 8702), including station wagons and racing cars
    contains 870360: Vehicles; with both spark-ignition internal combustion piston engine and electric motor for propulsion, capable of being charged by plugging to external source of electric power
    contains 870380: Vehicles; with only electric motor for propulsion

Answer "none" if no option can cover these goods.

data.reason: An electric pedal-assist bicycle is a cycle fitted with an auxiliary electric motor, which heading 8711 (subheading 871160) covers, whereas 8703 covers motor cars and similar vehicles.
